description: Defines the prach_subcarrier_spacing enum and related functions for handling subcarrier spacing in 5G NR random access procedures.

methods.name: is_scs_valid
methods.description: Checks if the SCS value is valid.

methods.name: is_long_preamble
methods.description: Checks if the RA subcarrier spacing is suitable for long preambles.

methods.name: is_short_preamble
methods.description: Checks if the RA subcarrier spacing is suitable for short preambles.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts SCS enum to string representation.

methods.name: to_numerology_value
methods.description: Converts SCS enum to numerology index.

methods.name: ra_scs_to_Hz
methods.description: Converts SCS enum to its frequency in Hertz.

methods.name: to_ra_subcarrier_spacing
methods.description: Adapts common resource grid subcarrier spacing to RA subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: to_ra_subcarrier_spacing (overload)
methods.description: Converts a numerical bandwidth in Hz to an SCS enum.

methods.name: to_ra_subcarrier_spacing (string overload)
methods.description: Converts a string representing bandwidth in kHz to an SCS enum.
